test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The dog was terrified by the unexpected noise.

options.text: The unexpected noise had terrified the dog.
The unexpected noise terrified the dog.
The unexpected noise has terrified the dog.
The unexpected noise terrifies the dog.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The unexpected noise terrified the dog.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and we need to change it into the active form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive form of the Simple Past Tense.
 
• The Simple Past Tense in the passive voice has the following structure: Object+ was/were + V3 + by + subject__
 
• The Simple Past Tense in the active voice has the following structure: __Subject + V2+ object__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Passive voice - *He was saved by me.*
 
• Active voice - *I saved him.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Active Voice: *The unexpected noise terrified the dog.*
